name: google-project-sync
goal: Same Google account discovers owned and joined projects automatically across clients, with revocation and account isolation

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Reuse verified Google identity and server-side membership. Projects refresh automatically across owned/joined account clients; revoked or old-account views are removed without leaking credentials. Local-only folders are not implicitly uploaded.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Current auth and invitation suites prove login and membership, while UI lists load only once. Extend existing hosted access, native connection and workspace listing suites with second-client changes, lifecycle disposal, identity races and revoked selection.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen tests at 008c7554 fail automatic discovery, stale/principal cleanup, lightweight polling, revoked offline copies and unpaired iOS account access. The standardized two-browser flow also fails to show the newly joined project after focus.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Implemented owned/joined discovery, visible-page refresh, revoked-view cleanup and independent iOS account access. Credentials remain native and membership checks stay server-side.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
